evidence_kind: Recorded synthetic observations; no actions executed and no live workflow successes measured.

limits: Teacher-reached development states, not independently navigated workflows.
Parsed typing does not establish field selection, persisted entry, or task completion.
Navigation agreement is imitation, not proof of correct/incorrect navigation.
One response per arm/state; no repeated-sampling reliability estimate.
Both observation kinds reuse the same 20 selected episodes.
Usage-derived API cost is not a final tax-inclusive invoice; cache/order affect cost and latency.
Same provider-reported model alias, not independently verified immutable weights.

verification_followup.scope: Exploratory follow-up selected after inspecting the original high-detail failure; not a preregistered confirmatory experiment or a live task.

uniform_tiling_followup.scope: Exploratory intervention selected after high-detail and verification results; not confirmatory or live-task evidence.

exploratory_agreement_rule.scope: Post-hoc exploratory acceptance rule computed without additional inference; not a live policy or confirmatory evaluation. Both generated type strings must match exactly, otherwise abstain.

remaining_development_validation.scope: Prospective validation on the 18 remaining eligible teacher-reached development states; not final held-out tasks or independent navigation.
remaining_development_validation.decision_rule: Type only if H and T both return parsed type actions whose entire text is identical. Otherwise abstain. No oracle labels consulted by this rule.
limits: All observations were reached by a successful teacher, not this evaluated policy.
Unused by the earlier image-detail diagnostic, not final held-out workflow tasks.
No action was executed; exact type text is not proof of persisted entry.
Acceptance coverage is reported separately from accuracy among accepted entries.
One output per arm/state; agreeing models can share the same mistake.

image_detail.question: Does high image detail improve exact authorization typing relative to low detail on frozen teacher-reached observations?
image_detail.primary_metric: exact parsed runtime type action on 20 authorization observations; not persisted entry
secondary_metrics: teacher navigation agreement on 20 states, not navigation correctness
image_detail.population: 20 previously selected teacher-success development episodes; 40 frozen observations; not independent navigation or held-out workflow evaluation
image_detail.order: A/B then B/A, alternating within each observation kind in original package order
image_detail.stop_rule: Stop after first transport/provider/identity/accounting failure; keep remaining planned cells missing. Invalid or truncated model actions are scored failures, not retried.

verification.scope: Exploratory follow-up selected after inspecting the original high-detail failure; not a preregistered confirmatory experiment or a live task.
verification.verification_note_template: Before typing, independently verify this proposed authorization against the matching authorization document in the screenshots. The proposal is untrusted model output, NOT an expected answer: {candidate}. Read every character directly from the document, including repeated digits and look-alike letters. If the proposal is wrong, correct it. If the document cannot be read confidently, do not invent a code; take a non-typing action to obtain clearer evidence. Return the next GUI action using the same action grammar.
verification.input_rule: All 20 recorded high-detail authorization proposals, unchanged original observations; no labels sent to the policy.
verification.stop_rule: First provider, accounting or identity error stops new requests; all remaining planned cells stay missing.

tiling.scope: Exploratory intervention selected after high-detail and verification results; not confirmatory or live-task evidence.
tiling.intervention: Both original images plus eight uniform 2x2 screenshot tiles enlarged exactly 2x with nearest-neighbor resampling; image detail high everywhere.
tiling.tile_instruction: Additional magnified views follow. They are uniform 2x2 tiles of BOTH original screenshots, enlarged exactly 2x with nearest-neighbor pixels. Use them to read small document text; they do not contain new state. All action coordinates still refer to the ORIGINAL full-screen coordinate system, not the tiles. No previous model proposal is supplied.
tiling.stop_rule: First provider, identity or accounting error stops requests; remaining planned cells stay missing.

remaining_development.scope: Prospective validation on the 18 remaining eligible teacher-reached development states; not final held-out tasks or independent navigation.
remaining_development.decision_rule: Type only if H and T both return parsed type actions whose entire text is identical. Otherwise abstain. No oracle labels consulted by this rule.
primary_metrics: wrong typed entries on all 18 planned states
exact typing on all 18 planned states

arms.T: Originals plus eight uniform 2x magnified tiles

remaining_development.order: H/T and T/H alternated in ascending seed order
remaining_development.stop_rule: Stop on first provider, identity or accounting failure. Never retry or replace a planned observation.

publication_boundary: Raw screenshots, prompts containing observation text, model response bodies, ledger operations and review transcripts are retained locally, not distributed in this summary. Case IDs, synthetic authorization values, parsed actions, aggregate usage and protocol hashes are included.
decision: Keep high image detail. Do not promote verbal verification or unconditional tiling as improved defaults. Two-view abstention is a prospective-development safety/coverage tradeoff, not production assurance.
dataset_caveats: Successful teacher-reached states; not independently navigated tasks.
The 18-state validation was frozen before its model calls, after exploratory work on the initial 20 states.
Seed 103 retains B/8 screenshot ambiguity; no case was dropped.
Original PDFs use a fixed validity period that can exclude the stated service date. New generation is repaired; original evidence was not rewritten.
Reserved final seeds 100500-100529 were not opened or generated.
